packages.note: You own in phase 1c: game/enemies/punk/street_punk.tscn (art = punk_art.tres), new game/actors/art/punk_art.tres (on punk.glb) and three variant CharacterArt resources for the A/B (punk_rest, punk_auto, punk_auto_rest), tests/bot/acts/look_acts.gd (add the perf act and an art-variant switch), readability_probe.gd and engage_meter.gd only if a real art Punk breaks them, the Punk fallout in any test, wiring fixes in humanoid_rig.gd, skinned_art.gd, rig_paint.gd, toon_materials.gd, ragdoll.gd and the room scripts (crowd_room.gd, test_room.gd, room_kit.gd), and new tests/test_art_punk.gd. Steps: (1) punk_art.tres on punk.glb; StreetPunk wears it through CombatActor.art; check() must pass. If it fails, fix the wiring or report the GLB problem; never loosen check(). (2) The open requests from phase 1 (P1-toon's and P1-post's; P1-post's are in its calls file): warm the art variants at room load (ToonMaterials.warm_up(room, <an art Punk instance>), windowed, 2 frames); crates, the dumpster and the car get hulls through ToonMaterials.environment(color, true) unless P1-post already did it; the edge pass reads edge_tag 0 on every hulled surface (check that the art and the hulled primitives get no doubled silhouette in first person). (3) Fix only what a real art Punk breaks; log every test change old -> new with a twin. (4) tests/test_art_punk.gd for all four GLBs, printing every number and asserting only what passes at the plan's bars (the rest is the gate's): A6 hurtbox fit, A9 framing at the 1 m acts' poses (compare_with_proxies, framing_problems at 2 cm), A10 marks stick, A11 the flash anchor within 2 cm of the skinned surface, and A19 strain against the SKINNED REST reference over every ANIM_IDS id and Punk move clip with the worst 10 printed. (5) The gate's A/B: a Debug-group switch (presets skip Debug, A9) or a bot argument through CAPTURE_ARGS that picks the variant, and first-person C2, C4 and C5 recorded for each of the four variants, with look_sheets.sh output. (6) Re-record C1-C11 and C13 on punk.glb, one act per process, beside the before pack; also re-record P1-post's E1 ('Look: edge pass and grade') and E2 ('Look: edge mask probe') with the real hulls, and check in first person that no silhouette, crease or line doubles on the art Punk or the hulled primitives. (7) Add 'Look: Perf, six art Punks' (one entry in acts() plus a function; reuse crowd_acts.gd's _sample_frames and _report_perf; the title must not contain or be contained in another act's title) and run it once with --force, marked NOISY. (8) The 60 s autopilot crowd act with art Punks: 0 errors, and M3's hard metrics R1-R3, R10, R11 met (tools/check_m3_log.py). Look at the C1, C2, C4, C5 and C7 sheets in first person and describe honestly how the Punk reads at 1 m.
